title: diplostachyum helveticum
intro: Diplostachyum helveticum, commonly known as the Alpine fir, is a plant species in the family Pinaceae. The Alpine fir has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include antispasmodic and expectorant effects, which can aid in relieving coughs and respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of the Alpine fir include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
